description: Admin-editable tier to curriculum level mapping. Edit via /admin/curriculum/tier-config. Changes take effect immediately without a deploy.

freePreview.note: Level 1 lessons 001-003 are always accessible to any unauthenticated visitor, regardless of membership tier.

_note_testDrive: Test Drive provides access only to lessons whose IDs appear in sampleLessons[]. A sample lesson can come from any level; listing it here does NOT unlock the entire level for Test Drive members.
